cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Prove We’re Close
cards.instruction: Get someone to take a social or emotional risk that demonstrates trust in the connection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've decided we should arrive at the reunion holding hands. I want us to trust each other in that room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They still think we're just friends. Are you sure?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I approve correcting them. You may keep hold even if someone stares.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Last time someone asked, you let go. You introduce me this time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. I'm assigning myself the introduction: 'This is my partner.' Then you may hold me to it, literally. Will you come in with me?
